test_intent: Verifies that when BanChatMember throws an exception, UserBanService re-throws it rather than swallowing the error.
reason: The test verifies important exception propagation behavior in UserBanService. However it has a real_env_or_api smell flag indicating potential external dependency issues. The exception re-throw contract is a real production behavior worth preserving. Rewrite to ensure all dependencies are properly mocked without any real external calls.

test_intent: Verifies that removing an approved user from global approvals returns true and updates storage state to unapproved.
reason: Clean unit test with meaningful state assertions on a concrete service. Tests user cleanup behavior which is a real bot contract. The mock_verify on logger is a minor smell but the core state assertions (return value true, IsGloballyApproved false) are solid and protect real behavior.

test_intent: Verifies that removing a non-existent user from global approvals returns false without logging.
reason: Simple negative case with state assertions. Low individual value but complements the positive case and costs little to maintain. Protects the no-op path of user cleanup.

test_intent: Verifies that removing a user from group-specific approvals returns true and updates storage state.
reason: Solid unit test with meaningful state assertions on group approval removal. Tests a real bot contract for per-group user management. State assertions on both return value and IsApprovedInGroup are protective.

test_intent: Verifies that removing a non-existent user from group approvals returns false without logging.
reason: Negative case complement to the group approval positive test. Low individual value but straightforward and cheap to maintain. Protects the no-op path for group cleanup.

test_intent: Verifies that AddUserManagementServices returns the same ServiceCollection instance for fluent API chaining.
reason: Only verifies fluent API return value pattern. No distinct bot contract exists beyond compile-time coverage. The extension method returning the collection is a standard .NET pattern with no production behavior to protect. Other tests in the same class already verify that specific services are registered.

test_intent: Tests IUserManager.Approved by mocking the interface and calling the mock, then verifying the mock returns the configured value.
reason: Tests a mock interface against itself with no production implementation under test. The mock is configured to return true and then verified to return true. No meaningful bot contract is protected. Factory smoke test only verifies object creation and mock setup.

test_intent: Same pattern as ValidUserId test but with zero user ID, testing mock against itself.
reason: Identical pattern to ValidUserId test - mocks interface and verifies mock behavior with no production implementation tested. Zero user ID edge case has no distinct contract worth preserving when the test itself exercises no real code. No replacement needed.
